component.name: Fedora Nova Settings
component.summary: Develop and configure the Fedora Nova desktop theme

description.p: Fedora Nova Settings is a responsive GTK4 and libadwaita control application for the Fedora Nova GNOME theme project.
The development build supports a safe preview backend when run inside Flatpak and a host backend for testing real GNOME changes.
Add in-app System Host backend and stock GNOME system profile.
